# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-07-03

## June 22, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.142.0 [new]
- `/usage` shows/redeems earned usage-limit reset credits; `/plugins` organizes remote plugins into curated/workspace/shared sections; configurable rollout token budgets tracked across agent threads.
- **Multi-agent delegation modes**: disabled, explicit-request-only, or proactive — governs when the agent spawns sub-agents.
- **Indexed web-search mode**: live searches while restricting direct page access; scheduled UTC reminders + current-time queries.
- (AIRT MEDIUM: multi-agent delegation-mode controls + indexed web-search = new agent orchestration/egress surface worth tracking; rest below bar.)

## June 18, 2026 — Codex app 26.616 [new]
- **Record & Replay** (macOS): converts demonstrated workflows into reusable **skills** (not in EEA/UK/CH initially) — new skill-authoring/replay surface.
- **Thread handoff**: move conversations between local and remote hosts with coordinated transfers; browser visible-tab routing + annotations persist across host moves.
- Bulk actions for run-history management.
- (ENDPOINT/AIRT MEDIUM: Record & Replay = user-demonstrated actions become reusable agent skills; Thread handoff = execution moves local↔remote. New agent capability + data/exec-boundary surface.)

## June 18, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.141.0 [new]
- Remote execution over authenticated, end-to-end encrypted **Noise relay channels**; cross-platform executor-native working dirs/shells preserved.
- **Plugin stdio MCP servers activate per-thread**; enhanced plugin discovery ("created-by-me marketplace").
- Realtime clients can append speech and control response entry into conversations.
- (ENDPOINT MEDIUM: per-thread stdio MCP server activation = per-conversation MCP tool surface; Noise-relay remote exec = new remote-control transport. Worth monitoring.)

## June 15, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.140.0 — minor, not reportable
- `/usage` token tracking; `codex delete` session deletion; `/import` to migrate config from Claude Code. (dev conveniences, below bar.)

## June 11, 2026 — Codex app 26.609 [reported 2026-06-12]
- **Developer Mode for Browser Use**: controlled **Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)** access (network, console, runtime errors, page state).
- `/init`; Computer Use for Enterprise geo-expansion; Windows App Access Controls; Rate-Limit Banking & Referrals.
- (ENDPOINT/AIRT MEDIUM: Developer Mode browser CDP access = new agent browser-control & inspection surface.)

## June 9, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.139.0 — minor
- Code-mode standalone web search; MCP tool schemas preserve oneOf/allOf; plugin marketplace JSON output.

## June 9, 2026 — ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.153 + Worktree/setup-script [reported 2026-06-10]
- Branch selection, worktree creation, environment setup scripts (arbitrary command execution at thread start), `/goal`.

## June 8, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.138.0 — Desktop handoff macOS/Windows; local image paths exposed.
## June 4, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.137.0 — Hosted web/image tools code-mode; parallel web search; multi-agent v2; remote-control pairing.

Updated: 2026-07-03 — New since prior scan: CLI 0.141.0 (per-thread stdio MCP, Noise-relay remote exec), app 26.616 (Record & Replay skills + Thread handoff), CLI 0.142.0 (multi-agent delegation modes, indexed web search). Reportable items flagged above.
